dataset_name: Apis mellifera x Plant x Region Master Dataset
regions: Asia, Central Asia, Europe, North America, Africa

tofilski_reference.primary: Machlowska et al. 2025 Scientific Data DOI:10.1038/s41597-025-06234-8

columns.latitude_approx: Approximate centroid latitude of country (decimal degrees)
columns.longitude_approx: Approximate centroid longitude of country (decimal degrees)
columns.known_subspecies: Apis mellifera subspecies known/native to this region
columns.bee_species: Scientific name of bee species (Apis mellifera)
columns.plant_type: Plant functional group (Crop / Tree / Herb / Shrub etc.)
columns.native_origin: Geographic origin of the plant species
columns.growth_form: Plant growth form (Deciduous tree / Annual herb / Perennial shrub etc.)
columns.nectar_sugar_conc_pct: Nectar sugar concentration (% w/w) from literature
columns.pollen_protein_pct: Pollen protein content (% dry weight) from literature
columns.pollinator_dependency: Degree of crop/plant dependency on bee pollination
columns.crop_value_usd_per_ton: Commodity crop value in USD/tonne (FAO/USDA proxy)
columns.bee_foraging_distance_km: Typical foraging radius of Apis mellifera for this plant (km)
columns.honey_color_mmpfund: Honey color in Pfund mm scale (lower=lighter; Lovibond equivalent)
columns.iucn_status: Conservation / cultivation status of the plant
columns.is_toxic_to_bees: Whether plant nectar/pollen poses toxic risk to bees (e.g. grayanotoxin)
columns.forewing_length_mm_mean: Mean forewing length in mm (Tofilski morphometric data)
columns.forewing_width_mm_mean: Mean forewing width in mm (Tofilski morphometric data)
columns.cubital_index_mean: Mean cubital index (wing vein ratio; subspecies diagnostic)
columns.body_weight_mg_mean: Mean worker body weight in mg
columns.tofilski_landmark_count: Number of geometric morphometric landmarks on forewing (Tofilski method)
columns.annual_temp_c: Mean annual temperature (°C) from climate lookup
columns.annual_precip_mm: Mean annual precipitation (mm) from climate lookup
columns.frost_risk: Frost risk category (Very Low / Low / Medium / High / Very High)
columns.bee_active_months: Number of months with active bee foraging in this climate zone
columns.bloom_duration_months: Computed bloom window duration in months
columns.honey_sucrose_ratio: Fructose/Glucose ratio (indicator of crystallisation speed; <1 = fast)
columns.economic_impact_index: Economic impact index = crop_value x pollinator_weight
columns.honeydew_source: Flag: is this a honeydew (not floral nectar) honey source
columns.toxic_honey_risk: Flag for toxic honey risk (same as is_toxic_to_bees)
columns.honey_production_tonnes: National annual honey production in tonnes (FAO 2022)
columns.hives_thousand: Estimated number of managed hives in thousands (FAO 2022)
columns.honey_yield_kg_per_hive: Mean honey yield per hive per year in kg (FAO 2022)
columns.fao_data_year: Year of FAO honey production data
columns.gbif_bee_occurrence_count: Number of Apis mellifera GBIF occurrence records for this country
columns.gbif_data_available: Whether GBIF occurrence data was retrieved for this country
columns.gbif_earliest_year: Earliest year in GBIF occurrence records for country
columns.gbif_latest_year: Most recent year in GBIF occurrence records for country
columns.network_connectance: Bee-plant network connectance (0-1; from pollinator network literature)
columns.interaction_strength: Qualitative interaction strength from network studies
columns.flower_constancy: Bee flower constancy to this plant (High/Moderate/Low)
columns.in_tofilski_2025_dataset: Whether country is included in Machlowska et al. 2025 SW Asia wing dataset
columns.tofilski_doi_2025: DOI for Machlowska et al. 2025 Scientific Data paper
columns.tofilski_zenodo_2025: Zenodo DOI for wing image dataset (Machlowska et al. 2025)
columns.tofilski_wing_images_n: Number of wing images in Tofilski 2025 dataset (17,457 for covered countries)
columns.tofilski_colonies_n: Number of colonies sampled in Tofilski 2025 dataset
columns.gbif_plant_sample_records: Count of plant occurrence records available in GBIF biodiversity sample
columns.data_completeness_score: Fraction (0-1) of key columns with non-null values for this row
